Update to Oct 23 01:00 UTC (data Oct 19-22 + today so far)

Still getting through

  • Adobe Sign Up (Key 2): burst on Oct 21 got through on three signatures at once: ct-before-cl + dp-spoof + dict-3 62k (84% verified), dishort300 + ja4-dict1 27k (85%), dict-3 + dishort300 32k (87%). Baseline ~3k/day. Smaller on Oct 22 (15k, 74%).
  • Wells Fargo Login (Key 1): ct-before-cl + dp-spoof + dict-3 steady ~32k/day at 74-76% verified every day Oct 19-22.
  • Adobe ARP FF (Key 8): down from 0.9-1.4M/day (Oct 16-18) to 61-130k/day, but still 51-65% verified on the pagebio and grease TTs.
  • Roblox Monetization (Key 4): 133k on Oct 20 on dishort300 + dp-spoof + ja4-dict1 at 59% verified, one day.
  • Tinder PreSMS (Key 3): 26.7k on Oct 19 on OS spoofing + page-bio null at 99% verified, one day.

New keys

  • Microsoft Identity Account Signup (Key 2): 31k Oct 21 -> 167k Oct 22 at 0% verified on secchua-webgl + dp-spoof, and 166k on the new dict-3 + dishort300 combo; still ~11k/h on Oct 23. Being stopped.
  • Amazon IDS (Key 2): ramping on the pagebio (12k -> 23k) and grease (16k -> 25k) TTs, verified falling from ~45% to ~19%.

Mitigated

  • Roblox Signup (Key 2): single-click + dp-spoof 174-224k/day and ends-te + dp-spoof 62-228k/day at 0-1% verified.
  • WBD Account Lookup (Key 20): 0.4-1.1M/day at 0-8% verified on the live pagebio TT.
  • Uber SMS (Key 1): grease and pagebio TTs fell from 19-25% verified on Oct 20 to 0-2% on Oct 21-22.

New candidates (not created)

  • g-di-dict3-st-1x-di-short-300-pxr1: create, scoped to Microsoft Identity Signup + Roblox Signup; watch Adobe Sign Up.
  • g-os-spoofing-pagebio-null: hold. Too broad (fires on normal Adobe Sign-in traffic); WBD is already covered.

Appendix — how these were found

Daily run 2026-10-23. Step 1: 40 flags with >=3 keys spiking. Dropped as definition changes, not attacks: g-browser-automation-swiftshader / -basic-render / g-spoofing-webgl-dimensions (created Oct 19, THR-1289, not includable), g-ip-timezone-same-country-wrong-zone (created Oct 20), g-h-capi-version-suspicious and g--e-cope-anomaly-wrong-build-id-for-capi-version(-4-6-0/-4-6-1) (CAPI 4.6.1 release Oct 20), g-ip-connection-type-velocity-* wired (edited Oct 21), g-ip-asn-reputation-high-risk-with-session-signal (created Oct 14, partial baseline), and the 8 spike-scan TTs created Oct 19-20. g--e-g-ja4-suspicious-verification-patterns + page-bio null hit 31 keys, but the Ensemble detector rewrites its JA4 list ~4x/day and it grew from 3-11 hashes to 25 on Oct 22, so it is treated as a definition change. Step 2 (16-flag vocab) found two new combos: g-di-dict-3 1x + di-short-300 pxr1 (10 keys, share 0.84) and g-operating-system-spoofing + page-bio null (9 keys, share 0.75). Both added as candidates with validated drafts.
